name: Muoi cheo
summary: Muối cheo is the salt the Quang Binh visitor portal’s 21 February 2025 article calls a Phong Nha salt for grilled chicken and grilled meat. A 13 March 2024 article on the same portal gives a herb list and serves it with boiled chicken, without placing that list in Phong Nha.
origin: Phong Nha, in the Quang Binh visitor portal’s 21 February 2025 article.
taste: The 13 March 2024 article says muối cheo is made from basil, lá lội, lá canh, green chili, and salt, and that boiled chicken is dipped in it. That article does not say Phong Nha.
howToEat: The 21 February 2025 article eats it with grilled chicken and grilled meat. It does not print the herbs.
The 13 March 2024 herb list is a different account. Both stay.
A shop, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Phong Nha, for the February account. A shop address is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Muoi cheo — the Phong Nha salt
seoDescription: The 21 February 2025 article calls muối cheo a Phong Nha salt for grilled meat. A March 2024 herb list is a separate account. A price is Check on arrival.
